<thought>Based on the 13C NMR data, the spectrum shows six aromatic carbon signals (≈130‑140 ppm) and two aliphatic carbon signals (≈38‑44 ppm). This suggests the molecule can be thought of as an aromatic fragment linked to a small aliphatic fragment containing bromine and oxygen atoms. The simplest SMILES representations for those fragments are a benzene ring (“c1ccccc1”) and a brominated carbon bearing two oxygens (“C(Br)(O)O”).</thought>
<final_answer>['c1ccccc1', 'C(Br)(O)O']</final_answer>
